source.title: Separare Inbox operativa e storico promosso
source.objective: Inbox architecture/UI noise observed in the acceleration chat: hundreds of already-promoted observations remained persisted alongside the small pending set, making Inbox look like a second roadmap even though promoted entries were only provenance/history. Keep operational pending view separate from promoted/audit history, with promoted records collapsed/archival by default and lifecycle ownership clearly shown.
